reviews.text:
Our “Mooky” loves going there as she's always excited when we’re driving there!
Great staff who understand animals and the difference’s needed of each one. Always responsive when I’ve contacted them or accommodating. Soulmutts is a bit far from me but worth the drive for the quality service and trust I have with them with my dog.
My Sky goes nowhere else!
Ally and her staff are amazing. My parents dog loves it there. It is clean and safe, and he has tons of fun. The grooming is very convenient.

Amazing experience with Soulmutts! The staff are incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely care about the dogs. The facility has a welcoming, home-like atmosphere, and it’s clear they put a lot of effort into making sure every dog is comfortable, safe, and having a great time. Love being able to see photos and updates throughout the day as well. Would highly recommend Soulmutts to anyone looking for a reliable and caring dog daycare or boarding facility in Toronto!

Soulmutts Toronto has been a great find. The space is clean, which immediately puts my mind at ease when I drop my dog off. The environment is upbeat and fun, and you can tell the dogs are happy and engaged while they’re there.

What really stands out is how reliable the team is. Drop-offs and pick-ups run smoothly, communication is clear, and I never have to worry about whether things will go as planned. I’d recommend Soulmutts to any dog owner looking for a place they can trust.
Amazing services and great people
I’ve had my dog groomed at Soulmutts a number times and am always happy with the results. Everything always looks clean and the staff are friendly and knowledgeable.
Took our family dog for a grooming, great service, great pricing and very dependable. Would highly recommend.
One if the best places we’ve tried. Strongly recommended! 👏👍👍👍
Great service !The facility is clean and well organized.l am really impressed with how they take care of dogs.Highly recommend SoulMutts Toronto!
Amazing service! It’s clean, hygienic, safe, easy, and professional. 🐶 ✅ …
The whole process was easy. MY Golden doodle usually doesn't do well with new places but she is treated like their own and she is always tuckered out when I pick her up.
So happy to have found this place! Beautiful facilities with caring staff that give me peace of mind while I’m away.
Highly recommend - can't say enough good things

Amazing Dog Daycare and Boarding Experience!

Soulmutts Toronto is a fantastic place for dog daycare and boarding! The team is friendly, professional, and genuinely passionate about caring for dogs. They create a welcoming and safe environment where dogs can socialize, play, and feel right at home.

It's great having peace of mind knowing your dog is in caring and capable hands. The staff really go above and beyond to make the experience enjoyable for both dogs and their owners.

Highly recommend Soulmutts to anyone looking for reliable, trustworthy dog daycare or boarding in Toronto!
Great space and people here, highly recommend!
Great job handling my little guy.   Handled with professionalism and care.  Thanks to the team that took care of him
Honestly the best service in town - kind, compassionate and feel so comfortable leaving my pooch here knowing she’s in the best hands with Soulmutts
The best service & friendly staff. 5-star well deserved!!!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
They provide the best daycare service, would highly recommend to pet owners
Excellent experience and our pup is always in great hands. Highly recommend!!!!

I cannot say enough about how much I love Soulmutts and how well they take care of my dog Oliver. For me, the real sign that Oliver loves it too is that every morning he pulls me towards the daycare door to get inside. Highly recommend!
So glad we found Soul Mutts for our Maltese’s boarding! He absolutely loves the place and all his friends! 🤍🧿 Grateful to everyone here for taking care of our little boi

My dog looooves SoulMutts. Daycare & boarding. I never have to worry about her while I’m at work because she is so well taken care of. The staff are so kind & keep me updated daily on my dog’s stay, moving her between rooms to suit her preference, haha. I trust them completely.

**Edit for your edit : I most definitely left my dog, with your team at your location for two weeks while I went to Spain for a wedding. Nice try, tho. I'm sure you have plenty of happy customers, but I was not one of them and I think people should know that experiences may vary.

I had my dog boarded here for two weeks while I went to a wedding. I assumed I was picking the best place possible for him. When I picked up my dog he stank INTENSELY of urine. His blanket and bed were given back to me soaked and smelling awful of urine. My dog had bite marks on his nose and leg, raw sore spots that I was never informed about. His elbows had the fur scraped off of them completely, I imagine he must not of wanted to sleep in a pee covered bed. I had requested updates but never recieved any, though I did reach out twice and was told he was doing well. Because my dog was not neutered, I was assured he wouldn't be placed to free-roam with the packs of large dogs, as in the past the larger dogs have had problems with him not being neutered and would react aggressively. My dog wouldn't defend himself, being more of the submissive type, so this worried me. When I asked one of the workers how he did when I picked him up, she showed me multiple videos of my dog humping other large dogs to the laughter of the workers around. I was shocked they wouldn't discourage that new behaviour. I didn't choose this place again. What I was told and what happened ended up being two different scenarios. I felt so badly for my dog. I paid for what I assumed would be a high level of care.

Such an amazing daycare and they treat and love your pets as if they are their own. My dogs have been coming here for so many years and are always so excited to arrive. The staff is so personable and communicative. So lucky to have this daycare and for my dogs to be so happy being there!
Our dog loves coming here again and again, getting groomed is convenient and the shuttle makes it easy with your busy schedule. Highly recommended.
Great home away from home for my Doberman Rocky!
Super reliable with a great team! My dog comes home happy, well-cared for, and tired every single time. Highly recommend!
Great place, exceptional service and staff! Very convenient especially with the shuttle that fits in with my busy schedule. Highly recommend.

My dog loves coming here and is always excited when it’s time for his grooming appointment. The staff are great with him, and he always comes home looking so good. The shuttle service is also a huge help with my busy schedule being able to have him picked up and dropped back off makes things so much easier. Definitely happy with the service and would recommend them!
Soulmutts is absolutely fantastic! They take amazing care of our sweet girl both daycare and overnight boarding. Our girl is always tired and happy when she comes home.

The website says there is “professional overnight supervision,” but when we went for a tour we learned there are 1-2 people present during daytime hours only to watch 3–5 rooms of dogs. At night, they rely on security cameras and there are no humans on the premises. This may be fine for some dogs, but it’s not a fit for ours. We just wish the website was more clear because it was a total waste of time for us to come for the tour.

Edit: just want to respond to the business’ comment below. We toured the entire facility and only saw one staff member. That staff member told us that there is only one person there on weekends because it’s slow. Whether there’s 1 or 2 humans on the premises, there were 0 humans in the rooms with the dogs, which were enclosed and only had tiny windows in the doors to see the animals. We mentioned that the lack of supervision would be an issue for Margot, and there was no discussion of other options or accommodations. It’s just disappointing to see that there’s additional pushback to this very legitimate feedback instead of just changing the website language to be more honest.

Three years and counting at Soulmutts with my golden retriever Reggie. In that time we've used daycare, boarding (multiple times), grooming, and the pickup service. We've had emergencies, scheduling chaos, a surgery recovery, and a wedding weekend. Through ALL of it Ally and the team have shown up with the same warmth, professionalism, and genuine love for the dogs. The cage-free, family- scheduling chaos, a surgery recovery, and a wedding weekend. Through ALL of it Ally and the team have shown up with the same warmth, professionalism, and genuine love for the dogs. The cage-free, family-
Adopted a retired racing Greyhoundnamed Whisper. She had never been around small dogs. Soulmutts did the most patient slow intro Ive ever seen at a daycare. Now she has a friend group. Magic.
The whole place has such a warm, family atmosphere, its like dropping your dog off at a relatives house.

Vizla owners will understand: Maverick has the energy of a small jet engine. We exercise him 2 hours every morning and he's STILL bouncing off walls by 11am. Soulmutts wears him out properly with structured activities, fetch sessions, agility work, and group play. He comes home and naps. NAPS. Voluntarily. A vizsla! Witchcraft I tell you.
Very conviennent pick up service. Reasonably priced. My big Husky absolutely loves Soulmutts!
I haven't booked any services with Soulmutts yet, but they were super fast with their response (a text) and followed up.  I appreciate that, thanks!

I just tried calling. There’s no answer. There’s a dog whimpering in the back. It sounds like he’s been out there for a while and no one’s out there with him. Are you open? I have a recording for you to hear it’s freezing out and it’s been a while. It’s been 30 mins the dog is still out there alone crying. The business reply is WRONG. I have never had interaction with this business before. I was walking by and hear a dog whimpering from the cold. I called no answer, I recorded it. 1/2 later a girl working came out. I think she forgot the dog outside. Happy to share screen shots and video on social media. I will not let this business blame or accuse me of lying for the welfare of the animal. This is serious

Soulmutts Toronto has been a great addition to our pet care routine. This place is a dream for any dog parent. They have spacious indoor and outdoor play areas, and the staff are consistently caring and attentive, making it feel like a true home away from home for dogs. My dog comes back happy, tired, and clearly well loved every single time.

When my mom was rushed to the hospital unexpectedly, I called Soulmutts in total panic mode needing immediate care for my dog Finn. Even though it was 7pm and they were technically closed, Ally said "just bring him over, family emergency always comes first." I was crying with relief! They kept him overnight and sent updates so I could focus on my mom. Having a place that truly understands that life happens and will help in a crisis is invaluable. They really care about their clients as people, not just customers.

The pickup service is SO reliable! They text exactly when theyre leaving, give a 10 minute heads up before arrival, and are always exactly on time. My dog Milo knows the sound of their vehicle now and gets excited when he hears them coming. The driver is super friendly and clearly loves dogs. Makes my life so much easier not having to worry about transportation logistics. Cant imagine going back to driving back and forth every day!

Our doberman Lucius is basically living his best life every time he comes here. When we’re out of town and he has to stay overnight, he doesn’t even pretend to miss us, he’s too busy thriving.

For day outings, they literally scoop him up in the morning like the prince he is and drop him back off in the afternoon, completely exhausted from hours of chaos, zoomies, and making new best friends. He wags like he’s going to Disneyland, and comes home like he survived a music festival.

The staff? Absolute gems. Super kind, super quick with photo updates (which I obsess over), and always easy to talk to if anything comes up.

We’ve been bringing Lucius here for a while now and trust me—we’re not stopping anytime soon. 💜

The agility equipment and playground setup is amazing!! My athletic German Shepherd mix Zeus absolutely loves the obstacle courses and agility challenges they have set up. Theres tunnels, jumps, weave poles - like a whole doggy gym! He comes home mentally and physically stimulated from working through all the different activities. You can tell they really thought about what would keep active dogs engaged. Not just open space but actual structured play equipment. So impressive!

What I love most about Soulmutts is how it feels like a real home, not some sterile facility! The whole place has such a warm, family atmosphere - its like dropping your dog off at a relatives house. Theres comfy furniture, cozy areas, and it just feels so welcoming and homey. My golden retriever Buddy is sensitive to new environments but he took to this place immediately because it doesnt feel institutional at all. Ally has created something really special here that feels more like family care than business care.

I love following their Instagram to see updates of my pup during the day! They post the cutest photos and videos of all the dogs playing and having fun. Its such a nice way to check in and see that hes happy while Im at work. They also share stories throughout the day showing different activities. The social media transparency really gives you peace of mind and makes you feel connected even when youre away. Plus the photos are adorable and always make me smile!

Really appreciated the thorough assessment they did with my dog Oscar before his first day. Ally spent time getting to know his personality and energy level to make sure hed be matched with the right group of dogs. The temperament evaluation was so professional and you can tell they really care about making sure every dog is comfortable and safe. No just throwing dogs together and hoping for the best - they actually take time to do it right. Smart approach that gives me total confidence!

Our little rescue Bella is super anxious and sensitive, and finding the right place for her was tough. Soulmutts has been absolutely perfect - they take such gentle, patient care with her. Ally really understands nervous dogs and creates such a calm environment. No rushing, no overwhelming her, just letting Bella go at her own pace. She actually gets excited to go now which I never thought would happen! They really specialize in making anxious pups feel safe and comfortable.

Love that I can get both daycare AND grooming at the same place! Dropped off Max for his usual day of play and picked him up looking absolutely gorgeous after a spa session. So convenient not having to coordinate between different places - Soulmutts takes care of everything. The grooming is top notch too, he always looks and smells amazing. Definitely makes life easier when you can get all your dogs needs met in one spot. Highly recommend the combo services!
I definitely made the right choice! I picked up my dog and I can tell he had a great time. It gives me the peace of mind to know that he is well taken care of, even when I'm away. Thank you!!
A nice clean facility that took very good care of our little pup. Good communication and great staff.

I texted for information on dog walking and this was what I received back?? No one answers the phone you have to text. I have no idea what they are talking about!! I have never contacted them before and I am certainly not now!! Business is terribly run by the looks of it!
There is so much chaos on a daily basis, with out of control behaviours,  excessive barking and yelling by staff, that I'm sure the dogs there must be stressed by end of day...would not  recommend!
I cannot say enough good things about Soul Mutts. They truly care about dogs and I love seeing how excited my pup is when he gets his holidays there!! Thanks for taking such good care of him again :)
Ally took such great care of my yorkie. what a great daycare centre!

I boarded my dog bean for a week here last year and I asked for updates given I’m a very anxious traveller regarding my dog (he is all I have) but they never got back to me. It seemed when I got there they were over having him too as the way they acted made me feel like he was a nuisance.

Yes the facility smelt extremely strongly of urine and I should have known the staff negligence of the facility then, it was my fault to choose them hoping it was toronto’s best care. I want to make it known I never make complaints ever. I look at everything in a positive light but this experience lingers in my memory all the time.

When I got there the staff member said “oh he’s going to be really happy you’re here” in a way that made me think .. he was unhappy or stressed and he barks when he is unhappy or stressed so I felt she was implicating he was annoying.

When I got him he acted in a way I’d never see him before- anxious disheveled frazzled. He barked so much that week he lost his voice. I wondered if he got any sleep.

I saw an employee share online thee fact that dogs were lumped together in a room of 4-6 and left alone overnight. That was it. He could not sleep if he was in an environment where he didn’t feel safe.

It breaks my heart because I know these fur babies don’t have long lives to begin with and now I’m wondering the impact on his health and lifespan if he was anxious and unable to sleep the whole week. This is one of my biggest regrets and I feel bringing him here was one of the worst decision I could have made as a dog mom and I regret it every day when I look at his sweet face. I wish I could take it back so much.

I am only remembering this now because I brought him to dogtopia which has cameras and would constantly send me updates in paragraphs and pictures and videos even when I didn’t ask for it. When he got back he slept sweetly and he made sure to say goodbye to the humans who took care of him, he loved them.

Please never bring your beloved pet here if you love them.

My anxious dog (a corgi/blue heeler mix), Ollie, I thought would be a handful for anyone let alone have him spend days at a daycare; I am completely shocked that he is doing so well here!

The staff are super friendly, dropping off and picking up is super easy as well, the billing makes 100% sense, I could go on but the most important aspect of all of this is I truly can go to work in peace knowing Ollie is being cared for and get cute little photos during the day.

It’s cliche to say, but 10/10 would recommend to anyone looking for a reputable and genuinely kind place to have your dog cared for 😇🥰
The staff was amazing with both of my dogs. An absolute great environment.
I had a fantastic experience at Soulmutts toronto! They come to pick up our dog in their shuttle to take him for a walk then drops him off. Amazing service highly recommend!
Great place. Great staff. Great service. 100% recommend!
Larry is always tired comming home from daycare at Soulmutts!
One of my favorite things about dropping off my dog here is it makes him exert his energy more closely to my typical work day. So our energy levels are more in sync every time I pick him up.
I'll keep this short and sweet... I wouldn't leave my dog anywhere else when I leave the country...  Trustworthiness is an important trait, and it's found here.
Fantastic experience! Friendly staff, clean facilities, and my pup came home happy and tired. Highly recommend!

As a dedicated dog owner, finding a trustworthy daycare for my furry companion was a top priority, and Soulmutts Toronto exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked through the doors, I could tell this facility truly cares about dogs and their well-being.

The staff is incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. They took the time to learn about my dog’s personality, preferences, and special needs, which made me feel confident that my pet was in great hands.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Danny! We truly appreciate your support and hope to see you and your pup again soon!

Previously had a great view of Soulmutts, but their invoicing system is horrible. We got a phantom invoice, no notification of it, and every time we try to reach out to resolve our messages are unanswered. But that doesn't stop them from continuing to send us more invoices
We’re so glad to have your support, Colin—thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you, Melissa! We're thrilled you had a great experience with us.
Thanks for the awesome rating, Damian! Your support means a lot to us.
Big thanks for the stars, Kirby! We hope to see you and your pup again soon.
The staff is the worst part about this business. Their apathy is everything wrong with pet care because they’d rather have your money than actually care about your bestfriend. …
